XECH-Table Lamp with Pen Stand (T2) – Smart, Stylish & Functional LED Desk Lamp

The XECH-Table lamp with Pen Stand (T2) is a modern, multifunctional lighting solution designed for home offices, study tables, kids’ desks, and workspaces that demand both style and utility. Combining efficient LED lighting with smart storage, this is perfect for professionals, students, and creatives who want an organized and well-lit desk.

Built with a Rechargeable Battery, this lamp offers complete portability and convenience. You can use it anywhere without worrying about constant power supply. The integrated Plant Pot Holder adds a refreshing touch of greenery to your workspace, enhancing aesthetics while promoting a calm and productive environment.

Adjustable Brightness for Every Task

Featuring 3 Levels of Adjustable Brightness, the lamp adapts effortlessly to your needs. Whether you’re reading, writing, studying, or working late hours, the soft yet focused illumination reduces eye strain and improves concentration. With LED Bulbs – 20 Lumens, it delivers energy-efficient lighting that is gentle on the eyes and long-lasting. The intuitive One Touch Operation allows you to switch between brightness levels with ease. A simple tap is all it takes to control the light, making it ideal for children and adults alike.

Flexible Gooseneck Design & Smart Desk Organization

The Flexible Gooseneck Design enables you to adjust the lamp angle exactly where you need light. Whether you want focused task lighting or ambient desk illumination, the bendable neck ensures maximum flexibility
and comfort. This also doubles as a desk organizer. The built-in keeps your stationery neatly arranged, reducing clutter and improving productivity. The added plant holder transforms your desk into a modern, minimal, and refreshing workspace.

Long Working Hours & Easy Charging

Powered by a high-capacity rechargeable battery, the lamp offers Working Hours – 6-8 Hours on a full charge, making it reliable for extended study or work sessions. The Input Type: Micro USB ensures universal compatibility, allowing you to charge it via power banks, laptops, or wall adapters. This rechargeable LED desk lamp is energy-efficient, eco-friendly, and cost-effective, making it a smart choice for modern homes and offices.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Lighting Source: LED Bulbs – 20 Lumens
  • Brightness Modes: 3 Levels of Adjustable Brightness
  • Control Type: One Touch Operation
  • Design: Flexible Gooseneck Design
  • Power Supply: Rechargeable Battery
  • Backup Time: Working Hours – 6-8 Hours
  • Charging Interface: Input Type: Micro USB
  • Additional Feature: Plant Pot Holder

Why Choose?

The stands out among LED desk lamps due to its multifunctional design, modern aesthetics, and user-friendly features. It is ideal for students, office professionals, and anyone looking for a rechargeable desk lamp with storage and plant holder. If you are searching for this product is the perfect match. Its compact design makes it suitable for small desks while still delivering powerful performance.
